news.title: Mizzou Alumni Association celebrates 2026 Gold Standard Award recipients
news.summary_en: The annual awards recognize alumni, faculty, volunteers, families and businesses for their outstanding contributions to Mizzou and their communities.

news.title: Mizzou students train service dogs to help veterans live more independently
news.summary_en: Through a partnership with Retrieving Freedom, students prepare dogs for future service while gaining valuable leadership skills.

news.title: Decades of dedication: Mizzou supporters commit $5 million to future Tigers
news.summary_en: Frank Shelden and Val Lawlor are building on their longtime commitment to Mizzou with a planned gift supporting medical education, Mizzou Athletics, and fraternity and sorority life.

news.title: Nate Leslie awarded 2027 Sinquefield Composition Prize
news.summary_en: Award includes a scholarship and commission for a new work to premiere at the President’s Mizzou Arts Showcase

news.title: Thanksgiving to-go meals return for Tigers celebrating on campus
news.summary_en: Campuswide dinners scheduled for week prior to break.

news.title: First-generation Mizzou student finds her calling in nuclear medicine — and helping others
news.summary_en: Once hesitant to ask for help, Allison Montelongo is now helping other Tigers navigate college and discover their career paths.

news.title: Mizzou students contribute to MURR’s continued global expansion
news.summary_en: Business students are using real-world research and data analysis to identify opportunities for MURR-produced radioisotopes worldwide.

news.title: Kinder Foundation® pledges $25 million to expand Mizzou’s global reach
news.summary_en: The latest grant will strengthen the Kinder Institute on Constitutional Democracy, expand its partnership with the University of Oxford and create new opportunities for students and faculty.

news.title: What’s the secret to a great sandwich? Mizzou experts explain the science
news.summary_en: From peanut butter and Cheetos to made-to-order cheesesteaks, Mizzou experts explain how flavor, texture and a little creativity make the perfect bite.

news.title: Mizzou celebrates 65 years of Peace Corps service around the world
